items.资讯标题: 医疗 AI 诊断：为什么很难成为一门独立生意？
items.desc: 抛开政策限制，市场体感中医院仍较难为 AI 诊断单独付费，因为 AI 诊断并非提供科室「从 0 到 1」的新服务，而是设备厂商既有软件能力的智能化升级：院端视其为谈判筹码，厂商视其为竞争壁垒，AI 诊断的真实角色是厂商守住市场份额和价格水平的「防守资产」，而非创收工具。价格立项闸口方面，医保局按「独立的医疗服务产出」定价，而 AI 诊断恰恰没有独立产出，因而不具备独立收费资格。从更宏观的视角理解政策深意，政策其实并没有「打压」医疗 AI 诊断——它只是严格遵循「以人民健康为中心、以临床价值为导向、控制人民群众医药费用负担」的总原则（2021 年八部门《深化医疗服务价格改革试点方案》），稳步推进医疗 AI 的技术进步。

items.资讯标题: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
items.desc: Every modality on one backbone: six 2B-class models (text, vision, audio, omni, and decision) trained from LFM3-1.7B-Base, including our first omni model and video input for our vision model. items.资讯标题: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
items.desc: Novelty judges assess whether a research idea is new relative to prior work, either on its own or in comparison with another idea. For example, we showed GPT-5.4 the same Human+Generated pairs – each containing one validated human-authored idea and one AI-generated idea – with two prompts. (All judges in this comparison ran once per idea on Human+Generated.) The agentic judge scored 0.78 macro-F1 – 11 points behind Claude Opus 4.6 at 0.89, and in roughly the same range as simpler Claude Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.4 setups – while costing roughly 10× more per decision at current API prices.

items.资讯标题: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
items.desc: For the researchers working to help them, the obstacle isn't a lack of effort — it's too much data, too few experts to synthesize it and a pace of discovery that can't keep up with the disease. The bottlenecks are not enough high impact scientific findings, too much data living in institutional silos and too slow a pace of synthesis to keep up with the research that is published. To use this data without compromising patient privacy or institutional governance, C-BRAIN uses a hybrid centralized and federated approach — where AI models learn from data at each institution without that data ever having to leave its walls.
